The fierce rivalry between Talleres Cordoba and Belgrano Cordoba took center stage on 2026-05-10 in a high-stakes Liga Profesional Argentina encounter. Both sides entered the pitch with immense pressure, knowing that pride and points were equally on the line in this heated local clash. Cagey Opening in Cordoba The match began with the high intensity expected of a local derby, though clear-cut chances were hard to come by in the opening period. Talleres Cordoba looked to establish dominance early on, but Belgrano Cordoba ’s defensive structure remained resolute. The physical nature of the contest was evident by the 28th minute when Agustin Falcon picked up the game's first yellow card. As the referee blew for half-time, both managers faced the task of breaking a deadlock that had been defined more by tactical fouls and midfield battles than offensive flair. Breakthrough and Rising Tempers Everything changed shortly after the restart as the visitors found their rhythm. In the 48th minute, Lucas Passerini turned provider, delivering a precise pass to Francisco Gonzalez Metilli , who finished clinically to give Belgrano the lead. The goal acted as a catalyst for a chaotic second half. Talleres searched for an equalizer, but their frustrations grew, leading to bookings for Valentin Depietri and Ronaldo Martinez . The situation went from bad to worse for the hosts in the 79th minute when Alexandro Maidana was shown a straight red card following a heavy challenge, sparking protests from the home side. Stoppage Time Madness The final moments of the game descended into disciplinary chaos as the referee struggled to maintain control. Deep into stoppage time, the tension boiled over. Talleres goalkeeper Guido Herrera received two quick yellow cards in the 93rd and 94th minutes, resulting in his dismissal. Simultaneously, Belgrano goal-contributor Lucas Passerini also received a second yellow card and was sent off, leaving both teams short-handed in the dying seconds. Despite the late drama and numerical changes, Belgrano held firm to secure a hard-fought victory in a match that will be remembered for its explosive finish.
